meta.name: Nevertheless The Shapes of Love
meta.description: After a painful breakup, Miu vows to focus on art and avoid love — until an encounter with an aloof, charming artist stirs her deepest instincts.

videos.title: I Shouldn't Hold Out Hope, But Nevertheless
videos.overview: Despite closing herself off after a devastating breakup, Miu finds herself drawn to an enigmatic, troublemaking artist against her better judgment.

videos.title: I Know I'm Not Special, But Nevertheless
videos.overview: While graduate student Osakabe struggles with a sense of inadequacy and unrequited feelings for a classmate, Miu and Ren can't seem to resist each other.

videos.title: I Shouldn't Take a Step Forward, But Nevertheless
videos.overview: Having left art for a job in advertising, Saki wrestles with jealousy and her attraction to a friend. Miu falls ill, and Ren pays her a visit.

videos.title: I Want to Cherish You, But Nevertheless
videos.overview: Miu worries about her relationship with Ren, especially when his beautiful childhood friend appears. Hikari mulls over Osakabe's confession.

videos.title: I Want to Be by Your Side, But Nevertheless
videos.overview: Ruki realizes he wants to be by Miu's side. Together with Professor Usami and Chiaki, the group heads to the countryside for an art retreat.

videos.title: You're the Most Important Person in My Life, But Nevertheless
videos.overview: Chiaki grapples with not being Ren's most important person and asks him for one final indulgence. Ruki takes Miu out on a date. Will Miu's heart be moved?

videos.title: I Know I'm Empty, But Nevertheless
videos.overview: After a tragic incident, Ren retreats from everyone and falls into a dark place. Saki makes an important decision and Megu gets honest about her feelings.

videos.title: I Know Forever Doesn't Exist, But Nevertheless
videos.overview: With a newfound sense of inspiration, Miu immerses herself in her art piece. Ren reflects on how his first encounter with Miu changed everything for him.
